verdict.rationale: Pulumi's 'Insights' policy features and Neo agent provide some AI-driven analysis of infrastructure (policy guardrails, plain-English task delegation), and the MCP server lets AI assistants query/search cloud resources, but there is no dedicated in-product 'insights/suggestions' dashboard shown generating proactive AI analysis of a user's own data beyond policy compliance and Neo's provisioning actions; one community report calls Pulumi's genAI documentation poor. missing for 10: concrete evidence of an in-product AI insights/dashboard analyzing existing resource data and generating proactive suggestions (not just policy enforcement or Neo's task execution), and independent corroboration of quality.
